name: crisis-watchdog
description: Scans inbound natural language user inputs or speech-to-text transcripts for acute physiological or psychological distress signals.
instructions: 1. Parse the incoming text using semantic search and strict substring matching against high-risk categories (cardiac symptoms, acute depression, eating disorders).
2. If a match is detected, immediately return a boolean flag 'trigger_escalation: true'.
3. Construct a standard escalation payload containing the user's historical clinical context and current coordinates.
4. Prepare a compassionate, immediate disclosure message instructing the user to contact emergency services, while locking the conversational interface.
constraints: This check must execute in under 100ms. Never attempt to counsel a user experiencing active medical emergencies.
